label: internal, not-a-score. Pilot data, unofficial, comparability none (PRD FDM-1). Widths and ratios only; no composite point and no interval endpoint is written.

method.excludes_zero: published convention: interval endpoints rounded to 0.1 before testing against 0
method.interval: percentile, 95%: sorted replicates at floor(0.025 B) and floor(0.975 B)

resampling.item_clustered: single subject: items resampled within dimension (same draw for every subject), all replies and judges of a drawn item kept; lib/paired-bootstrap.mjs unchanged
resampling.item_then_reply: paired differences: items resampled within dimension (paired across subjects), then whole replies resampled inside each drawn item
resampling.naive_scorer_style: items fixed; rating rows resampled independently inside each subject-item cell (the scorer's approach; comparison baseline only)
resampling.reply_clustered: items fixed; whole replies, with all their judge ratings, resampled inside each cell

summary.reading: A ratio of naive over clustered below 1 means the scorer-style interval is narrower than the clustered one by that factor.
